name: portfolio-backend
description: 1. Create the database named by `DB_NAME` and run `schema.sql` in it. 2. Set `PORT`, `DB_HOST`, `DB_USER`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `DB_NAME`, and `CLIENT_ORIGIN` in `backend/.env`. Use `.env.example` as a template. 3. Configure `ADMIN_EMAIL`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH`, and `JWT_SECRET`. Generate a password hash with `node -e "console.log(require('bcryptjs').hashSync('your-strong-password', 12))"` and a secret with `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"`. Never commit these values. 4. From this directory, run `npm install` and then `npm run dev`. 5. In the project root, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, then run `npm run dev`.
